editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood Italian institution in Irving Park where generous portions, tableside theatrics, and warm hospitality create the kind of old-school dining experience that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or make a reservation—the place fills up quickly. Don't miss the tableside dessert preparations like banana flambé and ice cream with fresh fruit, which reviewers rave about as a memorable show.

topDishes.note: Described as amazing with perfectly balanced flavors
